# telnyx_display_identity_record (Resource)

A Display Identity Record (DIR) for Branded Calling: the name, logo and call reasons shown to the people an enterprise calls. Edit it while it is a draft, then submit it with the telnyx_display_identity_record_submit action.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The name and call reasons shown when Acme calls its customers.
resource "telnyx_display_identity_record" "acme" {
  enterprise_id             = telnyx_enterprise.acme.id
  display_name              = "Acme"
  call_reasons              = ["Appointment reminders", "Delivery updates"]
  authorizer_name           = "Ada Lovelace"
  authorizer_email          = "ada@acme.example.com"
  certify_brand_is_accurate = true
  certify_no_shaft_content  = true
  certify_ip_ownership      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authorizer_email` (String) Contact email of the authorizer. Telnyx may send verification or infringement-notice email here; use a monitored mailbox.
- `authorizer_name` (String) Name of the person at your enterprise who is authorizing this DIR registration. Must be a real individual (used for audit and trademark-claim contests).
- `call_reasons` (List of String) 1–10 reasons your business calls customers. Validate phrasing against `POST /call_reasons/validate`.
- `certify_brand_is_accurate` (Boolean) Certification that the DIR information is accurate. Must be `true` for the DIR to be submitted for vetting.
- `certify_ip_ownership` (Boolean) Must be `true`. Confirms ownership of any logos/trademarks shown.
- `certify_no_shaft_content` (Boolean) Must be `true`. Confirms this DIR is not used for SHAFT content (Sex, Hate, Alcohol, Firearms, Tobacco) where prohibited.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown to call recipients. No emoji; not whitespace-only.
- `enterprise_id` (String) The enterprise id.

### Optional

- `bpo_authorizations` (Attributes List) Optional. Approved BPO (Business Process Outsourcer) accounts on your organization authorized to place branded calls for this DIR, each with the signed Letter of Authorization the Brand Owner granted it. Each authorization starts `pending` and takes effect only after an admin reviews its Letter of Authorization. Omit or send an empty list to authorize no BPO on this DIR. Maximum 10. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bpo_authorizations))
- `documents` (Attributes List) Supporting documents. Each `document_id` may appear at most once on a DIR. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--documents))
- `logo_url` (String) Publicly accessible HTTPS URL (max 128 chars) to a 256x256 BMP logo (max 1 MB).
- `reselling` (Boolean) Set to true if your organization places calls on behalf of other enterprises (BPO/reseller).
- `webhook_url` (String) `https://` URL that receives webhook notifications for this DIR's compliance-review outcomes. `null` when not subscribed.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `delete_requested_at` (String) When deletion was requested. Set once the DIR enters `delete_requested`; `null` otherwise.
- `expiring_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `rejected_at` (String)
- `rejection_reasons` (Attributes List) Populated when `status` is `rejected`; cleared on `/submit` or successful approval. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rejection_reasons))
- `status` (String) DIR lifecycle status. - `draft` - newly created; editable; not yet submitted. - `submitted` / `in_review` - Telnyx is reviewing. - `verified` - approved; phone numbers may be attached. - `rejected` - Telnyx rejected this submission; `rejection_reasons` is populated; customer can edit and resubmit. - `unsuccessful` - system-side error during processing; customer can edit and resubmit. - `suspended` - temporarily disabled (e.g. by an active infringement claim). - `expired` - verification expired; customer must resubmit. - `infringement_claimed` - a trademark/impersonation claim is open against this DIR. - `permanently_rejected` - terminal; cannot be resubmitted. - `delete_requested` - you have requested deletion; the DIR still exists and Telnyx is completing the removal (de-registration and cleanup). A verified DIR keeps serving its branded identity, and keeps billing, until the removal finishes.
- `submitted_at` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `verified_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--bpo_authorizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bpo_authorizations`

Required:

- `bpo_enterprise_id` (String) Enterprise id of an approved BPO (Business Process Outsourcer) account on your organization to authorize for this DIR. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `loa_document_id` (String) Id of the signed Letter of Authorization document (uploaded via the Telnyx Documents API) in which the Brand Owner authorizes this BPO. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.


<a id="nestedatt--documents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `documents`

Optional:

- `description` (String) An optional note describing this document, for example what it proves.
- `document_id` (String) Id returned by the Telnyx Documents API after you upload the file (upload via `POST /v2/documents`; see https://developers.telnyx.com/api/documents).
- `document_type` (String) Type of supporting document. Pick the closest match to what the file actually contains; `other` triggers manual vetting and may slow approval. The matching short_name reference list is at `GET /v2/dir/document_types`. One of `articles_of_incorporation`, `bank_reference_letter`, `bank_statement`, `business_credit_report`, `business_license`, `business_registration`, `certificate_of_good_standing`, `ein_letter`, `government_id`, `letter_of_authorization`, `other`, `professional_license`, `tax_document`, `trademark_registration`, `utility_bill`, `website_ownership`.


<a id="nestedatt--rejection_reasons"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rejection_reasons`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String)
- `detail` (String)
- `message` (String) Customer-visible free-text comment from the Telnyx vetting team. Only the first entry of `rejection_reasons` carries this; the rest are `null`.
- `title` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_display_identity_record.example <enterprise_id>/<id>
```
